name: Camp Afro Foli Drum and Dance Retreat
description:
# Camp Afro Foli Drum and Dance Retreat

\\nCamp Afro Foli Drum & Dance Summer Retreat 2018 brings you world-class artists from Africa, Japan, Belgium & Australia in a 3 day retreat on the beautiful beach vibes of Bribie Island! \\n \\nThere will be workshops in African dance, Dundun dance, African Drumming- levels, Dundun drumming, Singing, Yoga and loads more. \\n \\nJoin Rhythm Culture for Camp Afro Foli Drum & Dance Retreat located on the beautiful Bribie Island. The camp will run over three days, 500 metres from the beach in a brand new location where there is dormitory style accommodation, facilities, and communal kitchen. There will be a fire, a show, catered food and loads of performances on the Saturday night. \\n \\nWanting to know more? [Click here.](/camp-afro-foli-drum-dance-retreat/) \\n \\nCAMP AFRO FOLI DRUM AND DANCE RETREAT \\n \\n_Terms and Conditions: All Camp Afro Foli Drum and Dance Retreat passes are non-refundable, non-transferable, and cannot be exchanged for classes or services at a later date._
